Questions, answered

Do I need to speak English?

No. The app works in 6 languages — English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, Turkish, and German. Pick yours inside the app and everything is answered in it.

Does it work for ABO and CBO?

Yes. The strategy module builds structures for both — ABO for testing angles and audiences, CBO for scaling winners — and tells you exactly when to move budget between them.

Do I need a website?

No. The PRO works with any funnel: a sales page, a checkout link, WhatsApp, or even a simple link in bio. The tracking setup adapts to what you have.

Do I need advertising experience?

No. The assistant guides you step by step — strategy, copy, audiences, and tracking — whether it's your first campaign or your hundredth.

What do I need to start?

A Meta Business account with an ad account and a pixel (free to create in Meta Business Suite), plus a product or offer to promote. The included Getting Started guide walks you through everything after purchase.

How do I access the app?

It's a web app — after checkout you get the access link and create your account with email and password. Nothing to install; it works on phone, tablet, and computer.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Billing is managed by Hotmart; cancel there in a few clicks and keep access until the end of the current paid period.

What if it isn't for me?

You're covered by a 15-day money-back guarantee. Request a refund through Hotmart within 15 days of purchase, no questions asked.
